story.title: the dark
paragraphs_en: One dark night ,Nicole was sitting in her grandma's favorite chair .Looking to the dark,blue sky.the moon shone bright, filling the room with dim light. The house was very old . Wind blew inside as the windows were open. the trees danced at night . Nicole wished her grandma was still alive sitting next to her reading mystery books to her.

Suddenly,the doors creaked open behind her."Go to sleep,Nicole."her mom said "okay,mom"Nicole replied. Nicole felt scared ,as it was past midnight and little light was coming through the windows.But she went upstairs to her room and settled in her comfy bed.

When morning came Nicole woke up to the sound of chirping birds."A perfect start to my day."she said . And headed down to breakfast."Hey Nicole,sleep well?" mom said."yeah"said Nicole. As her mom cooked breakfast for her ,Nicole started to read her favorite mystery book, "the book scavenger". After breakfast, Nicole called her best friend, Roma.

"hey, whats up"says Roma."nothing much just finished breakfast.""okay then im gonna be waiting for you at school."so Nicole took her back pack and headed out the door.Nicole slowly walked to school,knowing she was to early anyways.

When she was at school, lights were all out and only all the students were there no one knew what had happened."this is a mystery .we must solve this"says Nicole."how do you know this is mystery?"Roma asked her."because i read a lot of mysterys and they all start like this. and this is what happenes.

So they started interviewing everyone they can find and not even one person witnessed anything."okay if no one knows anything then we start looking for clues"says Nicole. "how do you know if thats a clue or not ?"asked Roma."its a clue if you see something that belongs to the teachers."replies Nicole. "okay ill start looking"Roma said.

"I found mr. ken's favorite pencil!and there are also a trail of pencils leading this way."Roma reported. "what are you waiting for ?lets follow it!"Nicole said. Very soon nighttime came and the room was pitch black.the trail of pencils still steatched along the school,Nicole and Roma walked,backpacks heaving on there sholders.

when they reached the end of the trail,Nicole saw a person guarding the fence to the greenhouse .she thought"is the garden were the teachers are trapped?"she said to Roma,lets go ask that person guarding the fence!""what if hes enemy?"Roma objected "okay then we sneak past.""okay."

so they tiptoed past the person and reached the end of the fence."Oh no! We forgot to take the keys from Mrs Chun!"Nicole said."Don't worry I got it, "Roma said pulling out the keys."I slipped it in my pocket when we where looking for clues." They turned the key around the lock and went to the greenhouse.
Nicole gasped in a circle, saw the headmaster and all the other teachers.and guarding them was the pencil company.Roma said okay. lets do this or they will know we are here.

They quickly untied the teachers and let them go back to their homes. "I love solving mystery's."said Roma."Me too,"says Nicole "Acually Roma asked,miss couter,who tied you up with the teachers?""I.. I don't know . he was masked."miss couter replied."Its okay,he will show himself sooner or later"Nicole and Roma said mischivingly.
